excluded_build_optional_policy: Every other TypeScript platform binary is excluded from this Linux arm64 design. No cross-platform support is claimed.

resolution_policy.basis: Traverse release-lock dependencies, optional dependencies and resolved peers from packages/agent. Resolve nearest node_modules ancestor; follow workspace links. Include the existing resolved peer/support packages conservatively. Add the selected TypeScript Linux-arm64 compiler and Node type graph for adapter build only.
resolution_policy.scope: Dependency inventory, not an npm installation lock or deployment manifest. Preserve path-specific versions when producing the future installation lock.

metadata_checks.registry_against_release_lock: Every selected external release-lock package integrity and all selected runtime dependency declarations matched registry version metadata. The three Pi workspace records are bound to exact published artifacts separately.
